Job Title: Maintenance Technician
Announcement Number: 24-04-105060
Job Classification: Installation, Maintenance, and Repair Occupations
Opening Date: 4/3/2024
Closing Date: 4/24/2024
Salary Range: $9.54 to $15 / Hourly
Job Title: Maintenance Technician
Job Duties: Perform preventive maintenance or service, such as cleaning, lubricating, or adjusting equipment. Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance. Order materials, supplies, or equipment. Install machine or equipment replacement parts. Read technical information needed to perform maintenance or repairs. Assemble electrical components, subsystems, or systems. Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order. Troubleshoot equipment or systems operation problems. Test, evaluate and classify excess or in-use medical equipment and determine serviceability, condition and disposition in accordance with regulations. Test or calibrate components of equipment, following manufacturer's manuals and trouble shooting techniques, using hand tools, power tools, or measuring devices. Keep records of maintenance, repair and required updates of equipment. Perform corrective maintenance, diagnose, troubleshoot and probable repairs on assigned equipment's. Estimate costs for labor or materials. Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning. Record information about parts, materials or repair procedures. Install electrical components, equipment, or systems. Repair electrical circuits or wiring. Other duties may assigned.
High School Diploma Required? Yes
Qualification Requirements: Preferably had 24-months of work related experience and posses knowledge of electronics or electricity. May also assign to perform preventive maintenance duties outside Saipan, CNMI such as Rota Health Center in Rota, CNMI and Tinian Health Center in Tinian, CNMI. Willing to Work on Flexible schedule. The qualifications, knowledge, skills and abilities applies equally to all applicants foreign and U.S. Workers
Full or Part Time: Full Time
Hours per Week: 40
Hours per Day: 8
Payment Frequency: Bi weekly
Overtime Available: Yes
Overtime Rate: $14.31 - $22.5
Rate x 1.5 per hour Exempted: No
Specify All Payroll Deductions: ***CNMI TAX*** ***FEDERAL WITHHOLDING TAX*** ***FICA TAX***
Required tools, supplies and Equipment to be provided: Workers will be provided, without charge or deposit charge, all tools, supplies, and equipment required to perform the duties assigned.

Comments: Job opening will be advertised in CNMI DOL. It will also be posted in at least two conspicuous locations at the place of employment or in some other manner that is visible to everyone. Applicants can apply by going online at marianaslabor.net and submitting their application. Applicants can also submit their resume to person@example.com or may drop the applications at Saipan Plaza Bldg. Ste. 208, Gualo Rai, Saipan. Applicants may also call the employer contact to inquire through telephone number 555-0100 or cellphone number 555-0100, Monday to Friday between the hours of 9:00AM to 5:00PM. Interview will be conducted for all applicants that meet the qualifications base on resume and or experience submitted in writing.
